note: The paired rewrite, declared before the run: filesys_grep's description gains its content-search clause and web_search's is adjusted to match, in ONE arm, with the option order FROZEN. The frozen order is deliberate — it makes the wording the only difference from the reference, so the delta is attributable to the pair and not to a permutation. Reference is the frozen floor_a recording. Conditions are the rewrite's, not the fusion's: a rewrite moves a handful of rows, so the bar is 3x the A/A floor (1), p < 0.05, no label worse than -3, and BOTH edited labels must net non-negative — the whole point of a paired edit is that grep's gain is not paid out of web_search.

conditions.name: C1 delta >= 4 rows (3x the A/A floor)
